paragraphs.text: Kher Keep is an ancient kobold stronghold located in the Kher Ridges of New Argive , part of the Terisian Isles on Dominaria .

Built before the Brothers' War , its origins are unknown, but at some point, the keep became settled by kobolds . Kher Keep is unique among fortresses- impervious to aerial assault, but defenseless from the ground. Despite its vulnerability, the keep was never razed, and the kobolds still retain control of the building thousands of years later, their numbers unabated. Through the ages, some individual kobolds have risen to fame, such as Rohgahh , his son Rograkh , and their descendant Rosnakht , while others have fallen into misfortune like being eaten by Prossh . The kobolds are considered an established nuisance, annoying even patient planeswalkers like Teferi and Jaya .
